title: A growing list of numbers
description:
Read any number of values into memory that grows as needed.

```
Numbers (end with 0): 5 3 8 1 9 0
5 numbers read (capacity 8)
sorted: 1 3 5 8 9
```
hints: `int *bigger = realloc(values, capacity * 2 * sizeof *bigger); if (!bigger) { free(values); return 1; } values = bigger;`: never assign `realloc`'s result straight back, or a failure loses the old block (lesson 4.02).
`qsort(values, count, sizeof *values, compare)` sorts; `compare` returns `(x > y) - (x < y)`.
requirements: Start with `malloc` space for 2 numbers and double it with `realloc` when full.
Check every allocation; on failure, free what you have and return 1.
stretch: Put the growing array in a struct with `push` and `destroy` functions.
